---
title: "Site Map"
subtitle: "Every page on this site, on one page"
toc: true
toc-depth: 2
---

This page lists **every page on the site in one place**, grouped by
section, so you can scan or search (`Ctrl`/`Cmd`+`F`) the whole workbook
at once. Use the page contents (right) to jump between sections. Each
entry links to the rendered page.

::: {.callout-note}
This list is **generated on every site build** from the pages the build
renders, by
[`scripts/generate_sitemap.py`](https://github.com/WhalerMike/modernization-workbook/blob/main/scripts/generate_sitemap.py),
so it always matches the site. To regenerate it locally without a full
build:

```bash
python scripts/generate_sitemap.py
```
:::
